title: Copán and the Gulf of Fonseca: a Maya city and a shared gulf
goal: Describe Copán and the Gulf of Fonseca, and say whose monuments and coasts they are, with cuyo.

sections.title: Copán and the Gulf of Fonseca: a Maya city and a shared gulf
body: In this lesson you read about Copán, a Maya city in western Honduras, and about the Gulf of Fonseca, which three countries share. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for saying "whose": *cuyo*, *cuya*, *cuyos*, *cuyas*.

items: I can say whose monuments or coasts I am talking about, with *cuyo*, *cuya*, *cuyos* and *cuyas*.
I can describe the stelae and the Hieroglyphic Stairway of Copán.
I can say which three countries share the Gulf of Fonseca.
